requirements.note: The installed private candidate enters the same synthetic coding session under a real PTY; R1 acceptance still requires reviewed hosted evidence.
R1 closes the implemented prompt-versus-reserved-command paths without claiming the later complete administrative command tree.
R1 implements and prefix-replays the ephemeral legal turn state model; R3 owns durable replay and recovery completion.
The installed R1 candidate preserves ANSI-free implemented headless output; R7 owns the stable automation contract and full operating-system matrix.
R1 preserves terminal, application, agent, provider, tool, and state package boundaries; R12 closes the requirement across the selected editor client.

supportedClaims: This manifest records local deterministic R1 candidate commands at the tested commit; it does not by itself establish R1 acceptance.
The same provider-neutral application and turn coordinator power the implemented raw, flat, text, JSON, and streaming-JSON candidate surfaces.
The local real-PTY suite verifies two synthetic coding-tool calls, a dependent follow-up, queue promotion, cancellation escalation, resize, inert paste, failure cleanup, and terminal restoration.
The private candidate tarball matches the reviewed 59-file inventory and passes isolated install, installed raw-PTY execution, and offline uninstall smoke.
deferredClaims: R1 acceptance, hosted Linux/macOS results, branch protection, and mainline merge identity are external records not established by this local manifest.
Physical repository reads or writes, command execution, verification processes, Git operations, worktrees, and sandbox enforcement are not established by R1.
A production model provider, arbitrary provider or agent compatibility, API-key onboarding, credential storage, or network access is not established by R1.
Durable sessions, continuation, resume, crash recovery, background supervision, and editor clients are not established by R1.
A public package publication, supported installation channel, upgrade, rollback, migration, or production uninstall guarantee is not established by R1.

knownLimitations.summary: The commit field identifies the clean source commit tested before the generated manifest file is written.
knownLimitations.impact: A later manifest commit intentionally points to its tested source parent and never claims to hash itself.

knownLimitations.summary: R0 remains an unmerged prerequisite while this R1 candidate is stacked on its candidate commit.
knownLimitations.impact: R1 cannot be accepted until R0 is accepted on mainline and R1 is rebased or otherwise proven against that baseline.

knownLimitations.summary: The generated local manifest records one host environment only.
knownLimitations.impact: It does not replace the separately required hosted Linux and macOS PTY and package evidence.

knownLimitations.summary: The R1 provider and both coding tools operate only on deterministic in-memory fixture data.
knownLimitations.impact: No physical checkout, real provider, API key, process, Git repository, or persistent user data is exercised.

knownLimitations.summary: The JSON and streaming-JSON candidate envelopes explicitly declare experimental stability.
knownLimitations.impact: R7, not R1, owns stable headless schemas, compatibility, and multi-provider conformance.

knownLimitations.summary: The R1 process-level PTY harness uses the operating system Python 3 standard library.
knownLimitations.impact: Python is a contributor and CI test dependency for this candidate, not a runtime dependency of the packed Robin CLI.

knownLimitations.summary: Package smoke verifies the temporary gzip archive, canonical tar, exact file hashes and modes, npm integrity metadata, install, PTY execution, and uninstall before removing it.
knownLimitations.impact: The inventory retains measured macOS-arm64 npm 10/11 and Linux-x64 npm 10 compression profiles, but the archive is not retained or signed; immutable release provenance remains R10 work.

knownLimitations.summary: Evidence schema v1 records partial requirement progress only.
knownLimitations.impact: No requirement is marked complete solely because the R1 candidate or this manifest exists.
